Brightwells publishes a “Classic Car Sale Report” for each auction.  
No 2023 report shows a total revenue of £1 million or more.  
The only 2023 classic‑car auctions for which a revenue figure is publicly available are:

| Date (2023) | Reported revenue |
|-------------|------------------|
| 8 April 2023 | £698,895 |
| 16 May 2023 | £824,725 |
| 16 September 2023 | £672,151 |

All three figures are **under** £1 million. Because no 2023 auction meets the first part of the question (revenue > £1 m) there are **no dates** that satisfy both conditions.  

Thus, based on Brightwells’ own published reports, there are no 2023 classic‑car auction dates where the revenue exceeded £1 million while being lower than the previous year’s sales for the corresponding month.
